title: Course sample
idea: Course sample: A useful lesson excerpt demonstrates teaching style beside a concise syllabus and known prerequisites.
audience: People who need to inspect course within a marketing surface.
worksWellWhen: A sample lesson can prove the learning format.
avoidWhen: Sample certificates or outcomes would imply unsupported credentials.
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic document layout through its inspect course priority and explicit commitment contract: Distinguish sample access from enrollment and guaranteed results.
navigation: Course sample keeps the current inspect course context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: A useful lesson excerpt demonstrates teaching style beside a concise syllabus and known prerequisites.
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to inspect course; a sample lesson can prove the learning format.
composition.priority: Distinguish sample access from enrollment and guaranteed results.

imagery.role: Support the actual inspect course context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Keep lesson content readable and move syllabus detail into clear disclosures.
Use a legible phone reading order; media never blocks the primary proposition.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the course sample structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no inspect course content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Distinguish sample access from enrollment and guaranteed results.
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized inspect course content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Distinguish sample access from enrollment and guaranteed results.
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active inspect course context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure initial transfer, layout stability and real image decode cost at the chosen device.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
